import pandas as pd

# Paths to source CSV files
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_70/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_70/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_70/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_70/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_70/training_4.csv",
]

dfs = []
for file in source_files:
    # Read each source file with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
    df = pd.read_csv(file, index_col=0)
    dfs.append(df)

# UNION all source tables (concatenate)
df_all = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Fix data types according to target schema:
# Target schema: ['GEO.id': string, 'GEO.id2': string, 'GEO.display-label': string, 'HD01_VD01': string, 'HD02_VD01': string, 'Year': integer]

# Convert columns to string first (to handle float strings like '29329.0')
# For GEO.id2, HD01_VD01, HD02_VD01, convert to string without trailing '.0' if present
def to_str_strip_float(val):
    if pd.isna(val):
        return ""
    s = str(val)
    if s.endswith('.0'):
        s = s[:-2]
    return s

# Apply conversions
df_all['GEO.id'] = df_all['GEO.id'].astype(str)

df_all['GEO.id2'] = df_all['GEO.id2'].apply(to_str_strip_float)

df_all['GEO.display-label'] = df_all['GEO.display-label'].astype(str)

df_all['HD01_VD01'] = df_all['HD01_VD01'].apply(to_str_strip_float)

df_all['HD02_VD01'] = df_all['HD02_VD01'].apply(to_str_strip_float)

# Year to integer (some may be float, convert safely)
df_all['Year'] = df_all['Year'].astype(int)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
df_all = df_all[['GEO.id', 'GEO.id2', 'GEO.display-label', 'HD01_VD01', 'HD02_VD01', 'Year']]

# Write to target CSV file without index
df_all.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_70/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read all source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_70/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_70/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_70/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_70/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
df4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_70/training_4.csv", index_col=0)

# Union all source tables
df = pd.concat([df0, df1, df2, df3, df4], ignore_index=True)

# Ensure column types match target schema exactly
# Target schema: ['GEO.id': string, 'GEO.id2': string, 'GEO.display-label': string, 'HD01_VD01': string, 'HD02_VD01': string, 'Year': integer]

df["GEO.id"] = df["GEO.id"].astype(str)
df["GEO.id2"] = df["GEO.id2"].astype(str)
df["GEO.display-label"] = df["GEO.display-label"].astype(str)
df["HD01_VD01"] = df["HD01_VD01"].astype(str)
df["HD02_VD01"] = df["HD02_VD01"].astype(str)
df["Year"] = df["Year"].astype(int)

# Group by all columns to remove duplicates and ensure exact match with target
df = df.groupby(["GEO.id", "GEO.id2", "GEO.display-label", "HD01_VD01", "HD02_VD01", "Year"], as_index=False).size()

# The groupby with size() adds a 'size' column, drop it to keep original schema
df = df.drop(columns=["size"])

# Write the final output
df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_70/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
